statement: On the frozen R10 benchmark, the uncalibrated local rule flagged all 2400 null evaluation trajectories. The calibrated scan null rates ranged 0-.10; on large_ar linear it flagged 20/200 (pointwise exact 95% CI .0621594-.150213), showing that its marginal rank guarantee must not be interpreted as conditional 5% control after one calibration. On small_iid last_tenth both global and scan flagged 200/200, refuting the prespecified detection-rate advantage; on fast_plateau_tail scan power fell from 1 at small noise to .07/.015 at large iid/AR noise. These findings concern declared synthetic laws, not arbitrary CatBoost trajectories.
limitations: Known analytic forms, one length256, windows8/16/32 and four Gaussian AR(1) noise conditions only; no general-purpose detector novelty or priority is established.

Evaluation binomial intervals are pointwise and conditional on one shared calibration. They do not include calibration uncertainty or provide simultaneous inference across72 rows. The worst-cell example is descriptive, not a multiplicity-adjusted hypothesis test.

The rank guarantee is marginal over exchangeable calibration/test curves from each included null law. Observed20/200 flags do not contradict that guarantee and do not by themselves prove a universal conditionalFPR.
Empirical flag rates are not proof of population probabilities1 or0. Power on fast_plateau_tail falls from200/200 under small noise to14/200 and3/200 under large iid/AR noise.
Global versus scan rate advantage on small_iid last_tenth was refuted. Improved localization there is descriptive and cannot be substituted as successful confirmation of P3.

Synthetic thresholds do not supply valid p-values for arbitrary CatBoost learning curves. No natural CatBoost mechanism, double descent, external review, human approval or publication readiness is established.
Independent review audited raw saved arrays and all summaries and used direct OLS on eight saved trajectories; it did not independently regenerate all curves or rescore the entire matrix.
assessment_basis: Report, complete saved raw arrays/metadata, all72 independently checked summary rows/intervals, every calibration order statistic and eight direct saved-curve OLS spotchecks; no scientific matrix rerun. This supports only the exact bounded empirical statement, not novelty certification.
